default_truth_boundary: Energy-equivalent scenario capacity only. Not spare grid capacity, not installed generation capacity, and not a deployment or job-loss prediction.

definitions.scenario_sentence_template: Allocating {share}% of {jurisdiction}'s annual final electricity consumption to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {workers} configured AI-worker profiles.
definitions.definition: Annual final consumption of electricity for energy use.
definitions.boundary_note: This is annual energy use, not power capacity. The EU27 candidate is refreshed from the official Eurostat API but remains candidate-not-promoted until the runtime gate is explicitly opened.

definitions.metric_label: retail electricity sales to ultimate customers
definitions.scenario_sentence_template: Allocating {share}% of {jurisdiction}'s annual retail electricity sales to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {workers} configured AI-worker profiles.
definitions.definition: Annual electricity sales delivered to ultimate customers.
definitions.boundary_note: This EIA metric excludes direct use. It must not be relabelled as all electricity use unless the source metric is redesigned.

definitions.scenario_sentence_template: Allocating {share}% of the world's annual final electricity consumption to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {workers} configured AI-worker profiles.
definitions.definition: Annual total final consumption (TFC) of electricity for the World, as reported in UNSD Energy Statistics Yearbook Table 34.
definitions.boundary_note: This is annual final electricity consumption, not available power or grid capacity. The official UNSD Yearbook value is a source candidate and is not promoted runtime data.
